formal_coordinates_domain: all n>=1, all rational quartics W
HasSum_and_tsum_domain: even n>=2, all rational quartics W
genuine_inverse_domain: even n>=2, all output vectors b:Fin5→Q

theorem_headers.name: transferMultiplier_natDegree_le
theorem_headers.header:
theorem transferMultiplier_natDegree_le (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]) :
    (transferMultiplier n W).natDegree ≤ 4

theorem_headers.name: even_add_two
theorem_headers.header: theorem even_add_two (n : ℕ) (hn : Even n) : Even (n + 2)

theorem_headers.name: exactL_eq_prescribed_actual_output
theorem_headers.header:
theorem exactL_eq_prescribed_actual_output (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]) :
    exactL n W = prescribedL (aggregate n W)

theorem_headers.name: transfer_actual_five_outputs
theorem_headers.header:
theorem transfer_actual_five_outputs (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (W : ℚ[X])
    (hW : W.natDegree ≤ 4) :
    aggregate n (transferMultiplier n W) = aggregate (n + 2) W

theorem_headers.name: transfer_actual_exactL
theorem_headers.header:
theorem transfer_actual_exactL (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (W : ℚ[X])
    (hW : W.natDegree ≤ 4) :
    exactL n (transferMultiplier n W) = exactL (n + 2) W

theorem_headers.name: quartic_actual_HasSum_and_absolute
theorem_headers.header:
theorem quartic_actual_HasSum_and_absolute (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Even n)
    (W : ℚ[X]) (hW : W.natDegree ≤ 4) :
    HasSum (actualSeries n W) (exactL n W) ∧
      Summable (fun t : ℕ => ‖actualSeries n W t‖)

theorem_headers.name: actual_chosen_exactL_transport
theorem_headers.header:
theorem actual_chosen_exactL_transport (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (r : Fin 5) :
    exactL (n + 2) (X ^ r.val) = exactL n (connectionP n r)

theorem_headers.name: actual_chosen_HasSum_transport
theorem_headers.header:
theorem actual_chosen_HasSum_transport (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Even n)
    (r : Fin 5) :
    HasSum (actualSeries (n + 2) (X ^ r.val)) (exactL n (connectionP n r)) ∧
      HasSum (actualSeries n (connectionP n r)) (exactL n (connectionP n r)) ∧
      Summable (fun t : ℕ => ‖actualSeries (n + 2) (X ^ r.val) t‖) ∧
      Summable (fun t : ℕ => ‖actualSeries n (connectionP n r) t‖)

theorem_headers.name: actual_chosen_tsum_transport
theorem_headers.header:
theorem actual_chosen_tsum_transport (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Even n)
    (r : Fin 5) :
    (∑' t : ℕ, actualSeries (n + 2) (X ^ r.val) t) =
      ∑' t : ℕ, actualSeries n (connectionP n r) t

theorem_headers.name: quartic_HasSum_transport
theorem_headers.header:
theorem quartic_HasSum_transport (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Even n)
    (W : ℚ[X]) (hW : W.natDegree ≤ 4) :
    HasSum (actualSeries (n + 2) W) (exactL (n + 2) W) ∧
      HasSum (actualSeries n (transferMultiplier n W)) (exactL (n + 2) W) ∧
      Summable (fun t : ℕ => ‖actualSeries (n + 2) W t‖) ∧
      Summable (fun t : ℕ => ‖actualSeries n (transferMultiplier n W) t‖)

theorem_headers.name: quartic_tsum_transport
theorem_headers.header:
theorem quartic_tsum_transport (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Even n)
    (W : ℚ[X]) (hW : W.natDegree ≤ 4) :
    (∑' t : ℕ, actualSeries (n + 2) W t) =
      ∑' t : ℕ, actualSeries n (transferMultiplier n W) t

theorem_headers.name: transferred_inverseMultiplier_eq
theorem_headers.header:
theorem transferred_inverseMultiplier_eq (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Even n)
    (b : Fin 5 → ℚ) :
    transferMultiplier n (inverseMultiplier (n + 2) (by omega) (even_add_two n hn) b) =
      inverseMultiplier n hn2 hn b

theorem_headers.name: inverseMultiplier_coordinates_transport
theorem_headers.header:
theorem inverseMultiplier_coordinates_transport (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Even n)
    (b : Fin 5 → ℚ) :
    polynomialCoordinates (inverseMultiplier (n + 2) (by omega) (even_add_two n hn) b)
        ᵥ* connectionGamma n = polynomialCoordinates (inverseMultiplier n hn2 hn b)

theorem_headers.name: chosen_transferMultiplier_eq_connectionP
theorem_headers.header:
theorem chosen_transferMultiplier_eq_connectionP (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (hn : Even n) (r : Fin 5) :
    transferMultiplier n (X ^ r.val) = connectionP n r

theorem_headers.name: selectedIntegerMultiplier_transport
theorem_headers.header:
theorem selectedIntegerMultiplier_transport (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Even n)
    (b a : ℤ) :
    transferMultiplier n
        (selectedIntegerMultiplier (n + 2) (by omega) (even_add_two n hn) b a) =
      selectedIntegerMultiplier n hn2 hn b a

theorem_headers.name: selectedIntegerMultiplier_parameter_HasSum
theorem_headers.header:
theorem selectedIntegerMultiplier_parameter_HasSum (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (hn : Even n) (b a : ℤ) :
    HasSum (actualSeries (n + 2)
        (selectedIntegerMultiplier (n + 2) (by omega) (even_add_two n hn) b a))
      ((b : ℝ) + (a : ℝ) * zetaReal 9) ∧
      HasSum (actualSeries n (selectedIntegerMultiplier n hn2 hn b a))
        ((b : ℝ) + (a : ℝ) * zetaReal 9) ∧
      Summable (fun t : ℕ => ‖actualSeries (n + 2)
        (selectedIntegerMultiplier (n + 2) (by omega) (even_add_two n hn) b a) t‖) ∧
      Summable (fun t : ℕ => ‖actualSeries n (selectedIntegerMultiplier n hn2 hn b a) t‖)

theorem_headers.name: selectedIntegerMultiplier_parameter_tsum
theorem_headers.header:
theorem selectedIntegerMultiplier_parameter_tsum (n : ℕ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (hn : Even n) (b a : ℤ) :
    (∑' t : ℕ, actualSeries (n + 2)
      (selectedIntegerMultiplier (n + 2) (by omega) (even_add_two n hn) b a) t) =
      ∑' t : ℕ, actualSeries n (selectedIntegerMultiplier n hn2 hn b a) t
